answer_1.quote: We conduct neural network patching experiments on dialogue systems. For eliminating offensive contents, we adopt the Cornell Dialog dataset ... For injecting easter eggs, we adopt the Daily Dialog dataset ...

answer_2.quote: The evaluation metrics include distinct-{1, 2, 3}, BLEU and embedding-based metrics.

answer_4.quote: We also invite three well-educated annotators to evaluate the generated responses with respect to two aspects: fluency and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate each generated response on fluency (how natural it sounds) and relevance (how well it matches the given context).
